review_candidates.title: Scrum Master
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives . Work closely with Project Managers, Product Owners/Business Analysts, and technical teams to maintain smooth delivery. Help teams establish and maintain clear Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD) . Requirements 3+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Coordinator, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role in a software development environme
eligibility_evidence: Experience working with distributed or hybrid development teams.
